subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up again on my earlier email about purchase-optimized retargeting for your Singapore catalogue. GlobalData now forecasts Singapore ecommerce to grow 17.7 percent in 2026 to SGD40.5 billion, and since Lazada-owned RedMart launched 30-minute delivery in February the speed bar for repeat baskets has moved. With acquisition running 68 to 84 dollars per customer and 3:1 the minimum sustainable LTV-to-CAC line, the abandoned-cart audience is the cheapest place to defend that ratio. We hold out a control group so paid purchases read as incremental to organic shoppers. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: 2026 SG growth + RedMart 30-min delivery (sourced) + ecommerce CPA band 68-84 dollars / 3:1 LTV:CAC
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ecommerce retargeting SG: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely development (GlobalData 17.7 percent 2026 growth to SGD40.5bn + Lazada/RedMart 30-min delivery, Feb 2026) plus REAL sourced CPA band 68-84 dollars and 3:1 min LTV:CAC; brand named only from candidates (Lazada); MobUpps holdout incrementality referenced with no figure; market context web-verified and in enrichment_sources; 1 question mark; native English; no sign-off; no X-not-Y.
